model_output.verdict: A product designer with solid named projects, but little showing what those projects changed.
write_up: Your resume points to product design through Loop Fitness and Brightpath Studio, with current customer-facing work at Ferry Street Coffee. It's common for design resumes to name the work without showing what happened next. Here, that makes it harder to stand out for product design roles, especially since your latest listed design role ended in February 2024.

The Figma design system is your best model: it names what you created, where it lived and the tool you used. Your current barista role accounts for your time, but a recruiter can't see whether you've done any design work since Loop Fitness.

Let's start with the Loop Fitness booking flow and add the problem you worked on and what changed, if you can substantiate it. If you've done design projects since then, add the real ones with dates. Your portfolio can carry the visual work, while your resume gives each project a reason to be opened.
